_doc: NPC_AI_SPEC §8 — LOD tier thresholds and rates.
Tier is assigned by AgentManager: a different region is always D; in
frustum and nearer than nearDistance is A; in frustum beyond it is B;
out of frustum in the same region is C.
`steering` is declared here for phases 2-3 to read; phase 1 has no
thinkBudgetPerFrame is the hard cap on thinks dispatched in one frame
across ALL agents (§8: never think everyone on one frame).
